description: Source code for INA237 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor data acquisition, configuration, and trigger handling.

methods.name: micro_s32_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts a signed 32-bit micro unit value to sensor_value structure.

methods.name: micro_u64_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts an unsigned 64-bit micro unit value to sensor_value structure.

methods.name: ina237_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: ina237_is_triggered_mode_set
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is in triggered mode based on configuration.

methods.name: ina237_trigg_one_shot_request
methods.description: Requests a one-shot measurement by writing to ADC config register.

methods.name: ina237_read_data
methods.description: Reads sensor data registers for voltage, current, power, temperature, and shunt voltage.

methods.name: ina237_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor sample data based on channel and mode.

methods.name: ina237_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as configuration and calibration.

methods.name: ina237_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attributes such as configuration and calibration.

methods.name: ina237_calibrate
methods.description: Performs calibration by writing calibration register.

methods.name: ina237_trigger_work_handler
methods.description: Handles trigger work, reads alert register, and invokes alert handler.

methods.name: ina237_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, verifies manufacturer ID, configures registers, and sets up triggers.

methods.name: ina237_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets trigger handler for sensor alerts in triggered mode.
